svg.title: Pundoku wordmark — D2 «Девять»
svg.desc: Drawn letterforms, not a font: monolinear geometric construction, stroke 22 on a cap height of 104 and an x-height of 76. No glyph from any typeface is embedded, so there is no font licence to clear. "Pun" carries the jade gradient; the right stem of its n descends below the baseline to y=236, repeating the tail of the nine in the mark. That descender is the debatable move — the wordmark also works with the n closed at the baseline.
